regions.full_page: I am certainly pleased to see your hope and confidence in the mercy and gracious wisdom of Almighty God in regard to your little Maurice. I had a very dear and amiale brother of that name Maurice Joachim Casey. He was very talented and from earliest childhood seemed to dream of being a priest. When 16 in his 3rd year in the seminary his health failed and he came home - a family disapoint- ment. However, he worked generously in promoting vocations and was extremely pleased to others take his place - especially our 2nd youngest of ten brothers - just now back from the missions in the Philippines with his mission Headquarters in St. Paul, Minn. - Rt. Rev. E'd F. Casey. - Well after 20 years roving when I was ordained and he served at my first Holy Mass, he decided to " ... try it again and after seven years further study was ordained - at 43 instead of 23. Thanks be to God a billion. So we will hope an for something of a miracle for little Mau- rice. I am going to pray my deceased Rev. Brother Maurice - and especially our Father Stephen Eckert - whose relic I am herewith inclosing to pray for him and if it please God that he be spared - and have a vocation. For Father Stephen especially we a hoping for miracles so as to promote his Cause of beatification first and then his canonization.
